tagline: 78k-star OSS Firebase alt — TypeScript monorepo + test-path security suppression

topItems.title: Route Without Inline Auth
topItems.description: app.get() declares a route with no visible auth middleware. If your app uses a global auth middleware, suppress this with a comment.
topItems.fixSuggestion: Either pass an auth middleware function in the args list, or annotate the file with `// testforge-disable-file authentication-bypass` if a global middleware is intentional.

topItems.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML with user input
topItems.description: __html is built from a variable. Verify it's sanitized.
topItems.fixSuggestion: Render the value as text (default React escaping) or run it through DOMPurify.sanitize() first.

topItems.title: Path Traversal Risk
topItems.description: window.open() path was built from a variable. Verify it can't escape the intended directory.
topItems.fixSuggestion: Resolve to an absolute path, then verify the result starts with the expected base directory. Allowlist file ids → server-resolved paths, never echo user paths back.
